name: Shimasaki Aoi
source:
One of the girls in Maika's group.
Although she and the protagonist have known each other for a long time, her large size and intimidating attitude makes her feared by the others, so they are not close friends by any means.

She has a blind affection for the protagonist, but she doesn't seem to realize it herself.

[translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ418575.html/]DLSite[/url]]
